thread.title: Apple on track to hit $1 trillion market cap - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: Apple on track to hit $1 trillion market cap - MarketWatch
text:
Apple Inc. AAPL, +2.50% is on track to become the first U.S. company to reach a $1 trillion market capitalization, as its share price has crossed above the $207.04 threshold in intraday trading on Thursday. The calculation is based on Apple's most up-to-date share count of 4.83 billion, which is as of July 20. The gains need to hold through the close for Apple to officially be the first to reach a $1 trillion capitalization.
